title: Doctor Payload Schema
description: Output shape of `qdev doctor --json`. Each section is a flat object whose fields are section-specific; only `name` is common to all of them, and later epics add sections without changing this envelope. Schema changes follow semver on schema_version; additive fields do not bump the major.

cache_schema_version.description: cache section: the version the cache database actually carries, read from it rather than reported back from this binary's own constant.

expected_cache_schema_version.description: cache section: the version this binary was built for.

schema_status.description: cache section: "ok" only when the observed version matches and no table is missing.

missing_tables.description: cache section: expected tables absent from the database.

entity_count.description: cache section: null when the cache is too damaged to read, in which case schema_status explains why.

finding_count.description: cache section: null when the cache is too damaged to read.
